# adlc_json_gpo_export (Data Source)

Reads a live GPO's SYSVOL content and renders it as JSON, in the exact shape `adlc_json_gpo` consumes - the mirror image of that resource: every security principal it finds becomes a portable `####Replace[DOMAIN\Name]` token instead of being resolved from one. Pair with the `local_file` resource from the `hashicorp/local` provider to persist the result, the same way `Backup-GPO`'s output isn't itself a Terraform concept for `adlc_backup_gpo`:

```terraform
data "adlc_json_gpo_export" "example" {
  name = "Domain - GPO5"
}

resource "local_file" "example" {
  filename = "${path.module}/json_gpo/Domain - GPO5.json"
  content  = data.adlc_json_gpo_export.example.json
}
```

Links, ACLs and WMI filters are not captured, matching `adlc_json_gpo`'s import scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "adlc_json_gpo_export" "domain_gpo5" {
  name = "Domain - GPO5"
}

resource "local_file" "domain_gpo5" {
  filename = "${path.module}/json_gpo/Domain - GPO5.json"
  content  = data.adlc_json_gpo_export.domain_gpo5.json
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the GPO to export.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The GPO's GUID.
- `json` (String) The exported GPO, as JSON.
